description: A single-panel property plot (no sub-panel labels). The y-axis is labelled "Yield stress [MPa]" and spans 0-500 in major divisions of 100 MPa; the x-axis is labelled "Al content [at%]" and spans 0-18 with ticks every 2 at%; dotted gridlines are drawn at both major divisions. Two series of polycrystalline as-cast Fe-Al alloys tested in compression at room temperature are plotted: open circles (labelled in the caption as the 10⁻² s⁻¹ rate) and filled circles (the 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ rate), each with roughly nine measurement points between 0 and about 17 at% Al, and a dashed straight line interpolated through each series. Both series increase monotonically and near-linearly with Al content, with the open-circle (higher-rate) series lying above the filled-circle series at every composition and the two fitted lines slowly converging. At 0 at% Al the open circle lies on the 100 MPa gridline and the filled circle sits between the 0 and 100 MPa lines. A separate open triangle marker lies above the open-circle trend at the highest Al content (just below the 500 MPa line) and marks the Fe-18%Al alloy that yielded with concurrent twinning. No numeric values are printed on any point.

observations.observation: The x-axis is labelled "Al content [at%]" and spans 0 to 18 with ticks every 2 at%; the y-axis is labelled "Yield stress [MPa]" and spans 0 to 500 with ticks every 100 MPa, with dotted gridlines at the major divisions.

Two data series are plotted, open circles and filled circles, each with a dashed straight-line interpolation; the open-circle line lies above the filled-circle line across the entire 0-18 at% Al range.
An isolated open triangle marker sits above the open-circle fit at the highest Al content shown, just below the 500 MPa gridline, and belongs to neither of the two circle series.
At 0 at% Al the open-circle point lies on the 100 MPa gridline while the filled-circle point lies between the 0 and 100 MPa gridlines.
No numeric values are printed on the data points; the highest open circle and the highest filled circle both lie between the 400 and 500 MPa gridlines at about 17 at% Al.
The caption assigns the open circles to the 10⁻² s⁻¹ and the second series to the 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ compression rate for polycrystalline as-cast Fe-Al alloys deformed at room temperature.
The caption states that the Fe-18%Al alloy yielded with concurrent twinning at both compression rates.
The interpolating straight lines indicate a yield-stress increase of 21 MPa per unit% Al for the higher rate and 23 MPa per unit% Al for the lower rate.

The citing text reports a linear increase of yield stress with Al content up to 18 at% Al at both rates, corresponding to a hardening coefficient of about 2.2 GPa for polycrystalline alloys, which is not sensitive to deformation rate.

The citing text states that usually two specimens of each alloy were tested and the yield-stress data differed by 3% at most, while the pure-iron yield stress was averaged from three rather coarse-grained specimens (Table 1).
The citing text notes that the tension yield stress equals the compression yield stress of this figure at the same rate and temperature.

subfigures.description: Single-panel yield-stress vs Al-content plot: y = 'Yield stress [MPa]' 0-500 (ticks 100), x = 'Al content [at%]' 0-18 (ticks 2), dotted gridlines. Open-circle series with a dashed fit, filled-circle series with a lower dashed fit, and one isolated open triangle above the open-circle fit at the highest Al content.
